## Key Projects

### 1. PriceBoost (Thesis / Tugas Akhir)
A price recommendation platform for Tokopedia marketplace products using XGBoost machine learning.
- **Backend & ML**: Go API backend, Python machine learning engine with XGBoost Regression, PostgreSQL.
- **Frontend**: Vue 3 (Vite).
- **Features**: Automated web scraping of Tokopedia product metrics, and exportable datasets validated with IBM SPSS (Pearson Correlation & Multiple Linear Regression).
- **GitHub**: [Mighty-SEA/PriceBoost](https://github.com/Mighty-SEA/PriceBoost)

### 2. 4Paws — Veterinary Clinic & POS System
Veterinary Clinic & Point of Sale management system for "4 Paws Pet Care".
- **Architecture**: Dual deployment via Go Fiber (Cloud Web App) and Wails (Native Desktop GUI `.exe` for offline clinic use).
- **Features**: Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Vaccination History, Veterinarian Queue, Inpatient/Hotel management, FIFO/FEFO Inventory Audit, and Operational Reports.
- **Demo**: [demo-petclinic.habiburrahman.web.id](https://demo-petclinic.habiburrahman.web.id/)

### 3. WAGate (Meow) — WhatsApp Gateway API
A developer-first WhatsApp gateway and notification infrastructure.
- **Tech**: Golang, Vue, shadcn/ui, Supabase, REST API, Webhooks.
- **Features**: REST API integration for transactional notifications & OTP, webhooks, multi-device QR session handling, and API usage dashboard.
- **Website**: [wagate.habiburrahman.web.id](https://wagate.habiburrahman.web.id/)

### 4. Catatin — Chat to Structured Data Automation
An automated WhatsApp chat management and ledger platform.
- **Tech**: Golang, Vue, shadcn/ui, Supabase, WhatsApp Automation.
- **Features**: Automated synchronization of incoming chat messages, payment proofs, and contacts into a centralized database with multi-agent management.
- **Website**: [catatin.habiburrahman.web.id](https://catatin.habiburrahman.web.id/)

### 5. Vetrico — Veterinary Clinic SaaS
Independently designed SaaS clinic management platform aligned with SNI 9184:2023 and SOAP DPJP medical record standards.
- **Tech**: Golang, Vue.js, PostgreSQL, REST API.
- **Features**: Lobby queue & TTV screening, SOAP records with 6-digit DPJP PIN lock, pharmacy dispensing, inpatient flowsheet, grooming/pet hotel, and multi-branch POS billing.
- **Website**: [vetrico.id](https://vetrico.id/)

### 6. OHM Registration — Course & Payment Portal
Production web portal for Japanese language course registration and student payment tracking.
- **Tech**: Golang, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL.
- **Features**: Student registration, participant panel, class group/session management, and manual payment verification & installment tracking.
- **Website**: [daftarkelasohm.com](https://daftarkelasohm.com/)
